biological_replicate.evidence: inferred: Four independent biological replicates were prepared for both stimulated and unstimulated conditions.

experimental_design.evidence: inferred: we carried out a global interactome analysis upon stimulation of DARC-expressing HEK-293 cells with CCL7. We first performed a co-immunoprecipitation step under cross-linking condition to enrich DARC-interacting proteins followed by their detection using mass-spectrometry. In these experiments, we also used unstimulated cells as a reference, which were lysed and immunoprecipitated in parallel to subtract non-specific proteins.
